description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit harvest and yield records with the planting and application records they answer to: each planting record with its id, reference, field, crop, the acres planted, the most per acre the planting and input records support and the moment planted; each application record with its id, reference, field, product, the moment applied and the pre-harvest interval in days it states; each harvest record with its id, reference, the harvest lot code, field, crop, the acres harvested, quantity, unit and the moment harvested. The signed report gives the harvests and the plantings, each harvested field against a planting record behind it, each planting’s recorded harvest against the acres planted and the yield per acre its record supports, each harvest lot against the field of origin it records, and each harvest on an application’s field against the pre-harvest interval the application states, and counts them, and names divergent harvest records: a harvested field with no planting record behind it, a yield recorded that the planting and input records do not support, a harvest lot with no field of origin in the records, and a harvest recorded before the pre-harvest interval the application records state has run; then a harvest record naming no lot and a harvest dated before the planting it follows, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No harvests, or harvested fields with no planting records beside them, leaves those points unverified. Fields, lots and records match by letters and digits, a harvest reads under the planting on its field and of its crop when both name one, a yield is unsupported when the harvests of a planting cover more acres than were planted or more per acre than the planting record supports, and a harvest falls inside the interval when fewer days than the application states have passed since the day applied. This reads whether every harvest came from a planted field, at a yield its records support, with its field of origin and clear of every pre-harvest interval. Verdict agri_harvest_divergent, agri_harvest_partial, agri_harvest_unverified or agri_harvest_consistent. POST /api/agri-harvest-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
